items.hed: Timberwolves beat the Rockets 117-107 at Toyota Center
items.insight: NBA.com lists Wednesday night's game final, Minnesota 117, Houston 107, in 2 hours 26 minutes, attendance 18,055. The page now has the Rockets at 7 wins and 2 losses and Minnesota at 6 and 3. Tipoff was 8:30 p.m. Eastern at Toyota Center.

items.hed: Texans play the Chargers Sunday at SoFi Stadium
items.insight: The club's transactions page still shows the two Nov. 2 lines and nothing dated Nov. 3, 4, or 5. One signs defensive tackle Naquan Jones, signs Joshua Pitsenberger to the practice squad, waives Jaden Crumedy, and releases Deuce Vaughn. The later line signs Crumedy and Daniel Sobkowicz to the practice squad and releases Kyonte Hamilton and Zaire Mitchell-Paden. Houston's news page points to Sunday, Nov. 8, at SoFi Stadium, for the Chargers game.

items.hed: Astros' Monday roster moves still stand: Correa activated, Reifert acquired
items.insight: MLB's transaction log for Nov. 1 through Nov. 5 shows no Houston moves after Monday. That day's log still has Carlos Correa, Mike Burrows, and Brandon Walter activated from the 60-day injured list, Evan Reifert acquired from Tampa Bay for cash, Roddery Muñoz and César Salazar selected from Sugar Land, and Jake Meyers sent outright to Sugar Land.

publish.notes: Staff only. Thursday AM. NBA.com game page Final, Timberwolves 117, Rockets 107. Texans transactions page still ends at Nov. 2. Astros MLB Stats API Nov. 1-5 has no dates after Nov. 2.
